en.name: Tree pose
en.subtitle: Balance & focus
steps: Face the camera and shift your weight onto one leg.
Place your other foot on your ankle or calf, avoiding the knee.
Bring your palms together and keep your standing leg tall.
en.focus: Find a still point and take a steady breath.

zh-Hant.name: 樹式
zh-Hant.subtitle: 可見姿勢檢查
steps: 面向鏡頭，將重心移至一腿。
另一腳放於腳踝或小腿旁，避開膝蓋。
雙掌合十，站立腿保持伸展。
zh-Hant.focus: 注視固定位置，平穩呼吸。
